renderer: deterministic Canvas 2D attention field with WebGPU capability signal
primitiveBudget: one flat negative field, twenty-four angular listening apertures, one returned attention axis, and four liftable absence changes
commitThreshold: attention must begin at the lit witness and withdraw at its deterministic returned witness; wrong witnesses, repeats, incomplete holds, and wrong replies remain geometry-neutral
memoryRule: a valid returned attention changes every aperture, turns the watched entry into an absence, and makes the reply the only next witness; four returns compound and remain liftable
interactionRule: pointer or touch attends to the lit witness and withdraws at its return; Enter or Space performs the deterministic return; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: WEBGL pressure shell, folded cadence, and absence arch -> flat Canvas 2D negative-space field
compositionRupture: continuous body and rail -> deep central quiet surrounded by unequal listening apertures
encounterRupture: source-to-exit pressure travel -> attend, withdraw, and let the watched site disappear
temporalRupture: route memory on a surface -> discrete absence history carried by global aperture production
mediumRupture: WEBGL mesh and p5 rendering -> native Canvas 2D drawing with WebGPU only as a reported capability
changedRule: Attention is provisional while held. Only withdrawal toward the field's returned witness can rewrite every aperture, and the watched witness becomes the next absence.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a flat constellation of angular apertures around a deep quiet. A valid return changes every opening, lays a counter-axis, closes the watched site into absence, and leaves four absence sites after four returns.
falsifier: Delete if attention only moves a cursor, one aperture alone changes, return order is cosmetic, later returns reset the field, lifting is inexact, or the blind image reads as a decorative constellation or generic particle demo.
deletionCondition: Delete v049 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish reciprocal absence from v046-v048 or if the returned-attention rule is not visible without labels and prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
